title: Three Nights and One Short Cable
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：Internet　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 Internet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1999 the engineer ① connected the Internet that no student in the laboratory would have recorded, and he said the connecting was the whole of the night. The ② Internet, meaning the network itself and not the cable, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; Internet, he said, is the only thing in a laboratory that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of Internet in that laboratory had the same short cable beside it, and the ④ Internet at the far rack, meaning the link they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Internet, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the Internet was the whole of the matter, meaning the access and not the network. The ⑥ Internet, meaning the access and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; Internet, he said, is either something you connect or the only word that means both network and an access. He said the access is the part they remember.

By 2004 the ⑦ Internet had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short cable. The ⑧ Internet of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in May, was one laboratory and three nights of recording; Internet, he said, is either the link at the far rack or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ Internet I remember is the Internet recorded in the file, which closed in 2006 and is still recorded as the quietest in the laboratory. ⑩ Internet, my mother said in 2008, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all Internet, she said, is an access that has agreed to look like network. She said the access was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 互联网；网络（指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 互联网；网络（指那张网络本身，与电缆相对）
C. 固定搭配：connect the Internet 连接这个网络
D. n. 互联网；网络（指留给孩子们点开的一条那一张）
E. n. 联网之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的互联网之事）
F. n. 互联网；网络（指档案里写到、被记下的的那一张）
G. n. 接入、连接（指一件事里人人都上却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 连接（抽象总称，指人人都上却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: connected the Internet that no student in the laboratory would have recorded
The Internet, meaning the network itself and not the cable
Every kind of Internet in that laboratory
the Internet at the far rack
the Internet was the whole of the matter
the Internet had become a line in a file
The Internet of the whole thing

answers.why: connect the Internet 意为“连接这个网络”，1999 年那位工程师把实验室里没有一位学生肯记录的一张互联网做了一遍。
Internet 意为“互联网；网络”，指那张网络本身而不是电缆，它经过了三个夜而在簿子上没有被记录。
Internet 意为“互联网；网络”，指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根细细的电缆。
Internet 意为“互联网；网络”，指最远那个机架留给孩子们点开的一条那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
Internet 意为“接入、连接”，指一件事里人人都上却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这次连接就是那件事的全部。
Internet 意为“连接”，指人人都上却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张网络，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
Internet 意为“互联网；网络”，指档案里写到、被记下的的那一张，到 2004 年这一张成了档案里的一行。
Internet 意为“联网之事”，工程师五月写道，整件事的互联网之事是一处实验室和三个夜的记录。
Internet 意为“互联网；网络”，我记得的是档案里记录过的那一张，2006 年接通了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一张。
Internet 为抽象总称，母亲 2008 年说，互联网是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的网络。
